sloka: महद्भिः कांचनैः वृक्षैः वृता बाल अर्क संनिभैः ।जातरूपमयैः मत्स्यैः महद्भिः च अथ पन्कजैः ॥४-५०-२९॥
transliteration: mahadbhiḥ kāṁcanaiḥ vṛkṣaiḥ vṛtā bāla arka saṁnibhaiḥ ।jātarūpamayaiḥ matsyaiḥ mahadbhiḥ ca atha pankajaiḥ ॥4-50-29॥

translations.english: There they saw golden fishes and huge tortoises in the pellucid water of the tank filled with lotus creepers.
